status: Exploratory summary chosen after inspection of k016 point estimates, while bootstrap execution was in progress; not preregistered evidence.
reason: A within-redshift age slope need not track a cosmology-relevant redshift-mean distance shift. Report both without interpreting their ratio as a surviving cosmological bias fraction.
contrast: B(0.7<=z<0.9)-B(0.05<=z<0.3), where B is the paired injected-minus-nominal distance shift on common supported occurrence IDs. This contrast cancels the global normalization. Use each replicate's own jointly resampled pair of bins.
paired_change: Compute retained-target minus externally frozen nominal correction high-minus-low contrast within the same replicate; also retained minus nominal-map refitted. Never combine marginal standard deviations as independent.
covariance: Preserve joint covariance across the four baseline-supported redshift bins and four estimands on complete replicates, plus each estimand's paired high-minus-low intervals and all support counts.
limits: Conditional attempted-occurrence bootstrap, not survey-systematic uncertainty or coverage-validated confidence intervals. Native failures and missing bins remain missing. No high-redshift extension above0.9, no cosmological fit and no claim that simulated W22 ages measure true progenitor ages.
